input.summary: Replace immediate cessation/deletion in § 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance and export/migration support, with deletion governed by §§ 11.2–11.3
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept immediate cessation of assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data on termination, which also contradicts §§ 11.2 and 11.3. We have replaced § 11.1 with our standard position: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates plus export and migration support, with deletion occurring only under §§ 11.2–11.3. We can work with 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, including export and migration support reasonably necessary to move to Customer or a successor provider. Vendor shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
